name: Ichijou Shizuku
source:
One of the main heroine. Been with [url=/c1039]Shiranui[/url] since the start, and remains the only partner of Shiranui. The bond between them is strong enough that they wouldn’t hesitate to sacrifice their own life for the other… yet they aren’t lovers. Her personality seems like that of a perfect, cool, analytical type, but with Shiranui, she is frank and quite violent. Her biggest weakness is Japan's culture. When she comes in contact with something like tatamis, or a kotatsu, she transforms into an hopeless human being.
Her power is relatively unknown and thus rare, but can be described as the control of energy when she duel-wields her machete.

[Edited from [url=http://whatistomato.wordpress.com/2010/07/09/a-tribute-to-evolution/]Warum's review[/url].]
